description: Real Rescaled-Range Hurst exponent computed from real historical bars at each real timeframe (15M/1H/4H/1D/1W). Reports real excess kurtosis of the real return series. Does not compute a true Hölder singularity spectrum (requires tick-level history this build does not ingest) — abstains rather than fabricating one.

ticker.description: Stock ticker symbol (e.g. NVDA, TSLA, AMC, GME, SPY)

name: mandelbrot_fractal_analysis
returns: Real Hurst exponent H per real timeframe, Fractal Dimension D=2-H, real excess kurtosis, and a disclosed realized-volatility-ratio proxy for time deformation.
